top.description: Player 1 background (Luffy + Zoro, Emperor/Current Era). Formato cuadrado 1:1, personajes a los lados, centro abierto.
top.prompt: A highly detailed, epic 2D anime illustration in the most current modern pirate action style, 1:1 square aspect ratio. A single continuous, seamless, and unified scene of an epic turbulent battlefield during a raging storm. On the far left, a young pirate Emperor with spiky black hair and a small scar under his eye, wearing a black captain's cloak draped over his shoulders, a red open shirt, and a straw hat, stands in an imposing Conqueror's stance, surrounded by thick crackling red and black lightning aura (Haki). On the far right, a fierce green-haired swordsman with a scarred closed left eye, wearing a dark green samurai coat, stands in a combat stance wielding three black-bladed katanas (one in his mouth, two in his hands), surrounded by a swirling purple and green energy aura and cherry blossom petals. The entire middle-center area of the cracked stone battlefield is completely empty, clean, and free of details. Epic thunderous sky, dark purple storm clouds, vibrant cel-shading, bold clean outlines, masterpiece. --ar 1:1 --no text, watermark, signature, UI, buttons, split screen, panels

bottom.description: Player 2 background (Blackbeard + Akainu, Current Era). Formato cuadrado 1:1, personajes a los lados, centro abierto.
bottom.prompt: A highly detailed, dramatic 2D anime illustration in the most current modern pirate action style, 1:1 square aspect ratio. A single continuous, seamless, and unified scene of an apocalyptic ruined landscape with rivers of glowing lava. On the far left, a massive, imposing pirate Emperor with a braided black beard, missing teeth, wearing a dark captain's coat, tricorn hat, and lots of jewelry, is laughing menacingly, surrounded by rising vortexes of dark gravity shadows (darkness power) and crackling white earthquake fractures in the air. On the far right, a stern, muscular Fleet Admiral with a red flower tattoo, wearing a white peaked marine cap and a white naval officer's coat draped over a red suit, stands with a furious scowl, his fist and arm completely transformed into bubbling, dripping orange-red molten volcanic magma and black smoke. The entire middle-center area of the battlefield is a flat, clean, dark obsidian rock surface with no objects or details. Intense dramatic lighting, red-hot volcanic glow, dark purple sky, bold cel-shading, masterpiece. --ar 1:1 --no text, watermark, signature, UI, buttons, split screen, panels

loader.description: Pantalla de carga: Luffy vs Kaido jugando una partida REAL y correcta de Magic. Vertical 9:16 mobile.
loader.prompt: A stunning and epic 2D anime scene of a card match in the classic One Piece style, vertical portrait composition, aspect ratio 9:16. Two characters are seated properly and facing each other across a stone battlefield table on the stormy rooftop of Onigashima, playing a game of Magic. On the left, Monkey D. Luffy (Wano outfit) sits upright, looking intensely focused at his cards. On the right, Kaido in his human-beast form sits facing him, studying his own cards. Both characters hold their cards facing themselves (only the card backs are visible to the camera). On the table, a detailed Magic: The Gathering battlefield is laid out: rows of fantasy cards, with some cards turned horizontally at 90-degree angle to show they are tapped, alongside neat deck libraries and graveyard piles. The background is an epic storm with crackling red lightning and dark clouds swirling around the colossal skull dome. Vibrant cel-shading, dynamic shadows. --ar 9:16 --no text, watermark, signature, UI, buttons, backward cards
